Signature Infusion

Doctor tailored infusion for you

from £179

  • Prices

The Signature Infusion is designed entirely around you. Rather than choosing from a set menu, you will have a consultation with one of our doctors, who will take the time to understand your health, your lifestyle and what you want to achieve. That might be more energy, support for your immune system, recovery after a demanding period or care for your skin and hair. Your doctor then builds a formulation specifically for you. Every ingredient is chosen with purpose and every dose is tailored to your needs.
